AFTER-VISIT SUMMARY FOR MARCUS FROST Lakeshore Diabetes and Endocrine Clinic - 03/01/2085 - Dr Amara Paige
Dear Mr. Frost, Thank you for coming in. Here is what we talked about. YOUR NUMBERS TODAY: weight 91.1 kg (was 95 last year, GREAT job), BMI 28.9, BP 104/71, HbA1c 6.1, glucose 79.5. WHAT THIS MEANS: your sugar is still in the "prediabetes" range. It has gone 5.9, 6.2, 5.8, 6.1 over the last 4 years. This is NOT diabetes. WHAT TO DO: - keep walking, even in winter, even when there is frost - no new medicine today. Ask about Wegovy or Glucophage only if A1c goes above 6.5 - recheck in about a year, March 2086 - your concussion from 12/16/2084 was cleared on 03/03/2085 SAFETY: we asked about violence at home. If you ever feel unsafe call us at (608) 555-0111 or your friend Hope. Questions? Portal: https://myhealth.lakeshoreendo.example/mfrost QR: [MRN 55-20917 DOB 08/23/2039] Printed 03/01/2085 15:30 by Y. Cobb, MA
